stem: Daisy wants to add a closing sentence to the third paragraph (sentences 11–16). Which sentence could BEST be added after sentence 16 to help close this paragraph?

options.label: A
options.text: The tables can be too close together for your dog.

options.label: B
options.text: Dogs don’t always like being out, especially at night.

options.label: C
options.text: Your dog might know how to do a few tricks.

options.label: D
options.text: This would make everyone feel bad, even your dog.
